## Appearance

Lida Marsh is a small, wizened little creature who is a mite of ten years old. Due to her diminutive size, she appears even younger than her age.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P3](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0003)_

## History

Lida Marsh was a girl from the fishing village at the harbour mouth, whose father traditionally sent a gift from his first spring catch to the manse for thirty years. Unprovided for with warm footwear, her feet became terribly cold until [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) took pity on her and gave her her own only pair of black stockings, along with her shoes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P2](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P21](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0021), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P39](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0039), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P51](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0051), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P27](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0027)_
